comments.author: MeowletteBlackpaw
comments.body_html:
Hi

As stated on the main page, this does not install as a standard drag-and-drop-to-Mods mod, you want to open the zip, and navigate to the folder included titled “Configs”

Drop that inside user/mods/shredder-MoreHideoutCrafts/src , or if you want to pick and choose to only use one or the other config, go inside configs and choose which config you want, and place it in user/mods/shredder-MoreHideoutCrafts/src/configs

Enjoy! Hope this helped!
